summary.en: Bohr models: protons and neutrons in the nucleus, electrons moving in shells around it. Choose an element to see its electron configuration.

info.en: Positive particles in the nucleus. Hydrogen has 1, which is its atomic number.
info.hi: नाभिक के धनावेशित कण। हाइड्रोजन में 1 हैं, यही इसकी परमाणु संख्या है।

info.en: The outermost electrons decide how Hydrogen reacts. Configuration 1.
